Ravi (Nova): hitting bursts of 401 then 429 during our onboarding smoke when we spin up 20 workers in CI. Only in the first 20s.
Lina (CS): thanks — which SDK + token strategy? any sidecars or proxies?
Ravi (Nova): node-sdk v0.5.0, ephemeral tokens rotated every 30s, and we have a company egress proxy that terminates TLS.
Diego (Eng): likely token rotation + connection churn. Can you paste proxy-observed headers?
Ravi (Nova): proxy log: authorization: Bearer eyJ...old, connection: close
Megan (SRE): connection: close + TLS termination = many new sessions, gateway treats them as independent clients and enforces burst buckets -> 429.
Diego (Eng): try SDK limits: concurrency=2, singleflight token refresh, and preflightCoalesce=true. Also stagger worker startup by 200ms.
Ravi (Nova): applied those changes and retried — initial ramp clear, no 401/429.
Lina (CS): we'll add this to your onboarding notes: "proxy TLS termination + connection: close causes preflight fanout; recommend keepalive or client-side caps."
Diego (Eng): ENG will add telemetry to detect high token refresh churn and warn users.
Ravi (Nova): thanks all, will coordinate infra team to allow keepalive on the proxy.
